Title.schinese: Mod 运行环境（BepInEx + DBModKit）· 适配游戏 {GameVersion}

Description.schinese:
[b]其他代码 Mod 都需要先装这个。[/b]

游戏的创意工坊不会自动加载代码 Mod。本条目包含 Mod 加载器 BepInEx 5 和公共依赖库 DBModKit，订阅后需要运行一次安装器。

[b]当前版本适配游戏 {GameVersion}。[/b]

[h2]安装[/h2]
[olist]
[*]订阅，等 Steam 下载完成
[*]退出游戏，打开 [i]<Steam 库>\steamapps\workshop\content\4246640\<本条目编号>\[/i]，双击 [b]install.bat[/b]
[*]启动游戏
[/olist]
条目更新后游戏里会提示，退出游戏再运行一次 install.bat。

[h2]卸载[/h2]
运行同一文件夹里的 [b]uninstall.bat[/b]，再取消订阅。

[h2]游戏版本[/h2]
游戏每次更新都会重新混淆代码，所以运行环境的每个版本只适配一个游戏版本，游戏更新后要等运行环境跟着更新。
游戏作者会在 Steam 放出历史版本（库里右键游戏 → 属性 → 测试版）。想固定游戏版本的话：
[list]
[*]切到哪个游戏版本，就用适配它的 Mod 版本。对照表和各版本的压缩包在 [url=https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods/releases]GitHub Releases[/url]，下载对应版本的「仅插件」包（plugins），退出游戏后解压到游戏目录覆盖（压缩包装的 Mod 优先于工坊版）
[*]固定版本期间本条目再更新，不要运行 install.bat，游戏里的更新提示可以忽略
[/list]

[h2]注意[/h2]
[list]
[*]按游戏作者的规则，装了 Mod 后成绩不会上传排行榜，其他功能不受影响。
[*]游戏更新后如果不兼容，进游戏会提示，Mod 自动停用，游戏照常可玩。
[*]BepInEx、Doorstop 为 LGPL-2.1，许可证和源码链接见条目里的 licenses 文件夹。
[/list]
Description.english:
[b]Required by all code mods.[/b]

The game's Workshop does not load code mods by itself. This item contains the BepInEx 5 mod loader and the shared library DBModKit; run the installer once after subscribing.

[b]This version is for game version {GameVersion}.[/b]

[h2]Install[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Subscribe and wait for the download
[*]Quit the game, open [i]<Steam library>\steamapps\workshop\content\4246640\<this item id>\[/i] and double-click [b]install.bat[/b]
[*]Start the game
[/olist]
When this item updates the game will tell you; quit and run install.bat again.

[h2]Uninstall[/h2]
Run [b]uninstall.bat[/b] in the same folder, then unsubscribe.

[h2]Game version[/h2]
Every game update re-obfuscates the game's code, so each runtime version works with exactly one game version; after a game update, wait for the runtime to follow.
The game's author is publishing older game versions on Steam (right-click the game in your library → Properties → Betas). To stay on a game version:
[list]
[*]Use the mod version made for that game version. The version table and every release's zips are on [url=https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods/releases]GitHub Releases[/url]; download the matching "plugins" package, quit the game and extract it into the game folder, overwriting files (zip-installed mods take priority over the Workshop ones)
[*]While you stay on an older game version, don't run install.bat when this item updates; you can ignore the in-game update notice
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]By the game author's rule, scores are not uploaded to the leaderboard while mods are installed.
[*]If a game update breaks compatibility, you'll see a notice and the mods disable themselves; the game still works.
[*]BepInEx and Doorstop are LGPL-2.1; licenses and source links are in the item's licenses folder.
[/list]

Description.schinese:
[b]需要先订阅并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod 运行环境（BepInEx + DBModKit）[/url][/b]（游戏的创意工坊不会自动加载代码 Mod）。装好运行环境后，订阅本条目即可，第一次加载时游戏里会让你确认。

游戏里右键技能图标可以开启自动释放，但原版只要冷却好、蓝够、附近有敌人就会放。SmartSkill 让你给每个技能单独设定释放条件。

[list]
[*]条件：自身血量、敌人数量、有没有 Boss、敌人血量、能斩杀的敌人数（处决、点金术、撕咬）、上一次效果结束后再放、保留充能……
[*]开关技能（献祭等）条件满足时保持开启，不满足时自动关闭
[*]不知道怎么设就点"按标签推荐"
[/list]

[h2]用法[/h2]
战斗中右键技能图标开启自动释放，点图标右上角的齿轮设置条件。装了 DBStudio 时也可以在 F9 → Mod 页里统一管理。

[h2]注意[/h2]
[list]
[*]按游戏作者的规则，装了 Mod 后成绩不会上传排行榜。
[*]界面目前只有中文。
[*]源码（MIT）和问题反馈：https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]
Description.english:
[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod Runtime (BepInEx + DBModKit)[/url] to be subscribed and installed first[/b] (the game's Workshop doesn't load code mods by itself). Once the runtime is installed, just subscribe; you'll be asked to confirm the first time it loads.

Right-clicking a skill icon turns on auto-cast, but vanilla fires whenever the skill is ready and an enemy is nearby. SmartSkill lets you set conditions per skill.

[list]
[*]Conditions: your HP, enemy count, bosses, enemy HP, number of killable enemies (execute-type skills), wait until the previous effect ends, keep charges, ...
[*]Toggle skills stay on while the conditions hold and turn off when they don't
[*]"Recommend by tags" fills in sensible defaults
[/list]

[h2]Usage[/h2]
In combat, right-click a skill icon to enable auto-cast, then click the gear at its corner. With DBStudio installed you can also manage all skills under F9 → Mod page.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]By the game author's rule, scores aren't uploaded to the leaderboard while mods are installed.
[*]The in-game UI is Chinese only for now.
[*]Source code (MIT) and issues: https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]

Title.schinese: Hextech：海克斯强化（参照海克斯大乱斗、斗魂竞技场）
Title.english: Hextech: augments inspired by ARAM: Mayhem and Arena

Description.schinese:
[b]需要先订阅并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod 运行环境（BepInEx + DBModKit）[/url][/b]（游戏的创意工坊不会自动加载代码 Mod）。装好运行环境后，订阅本条目即可；第一次加载时游戏里会让你确认。

[b]0.31.0 需要最新的运行环境：更新后退出游戏，重新运行运行环境条目里的 install.bat。[/b]

每局 4 次三选一（开局一次，之后在大约 1/4、1/2、3/4 波次的遗物回合后各一次），参照 LoL 海克斯大乱斗和斗魂竞技场。

[list]
[*][b]专属强化[/b]：强化英雄的专属技能：伤害、冷却、蓝耗、持续时间、充能，或者"释放时加攻速 / 护甲 / 无敌 / 回血""技能击杀返还冷却""免费再放一次"
[*][b]招牌强化[/b]（银 / 金 / 棱彩）：沙漠死神「邦」、男枪「大炮」、哥布林之王「叠角龙」、炸弹客「核弹」、雷电「雷神」
[*][b]通用强化[/b]（所有英雄都能抽）：大力、灵巧、嗜血、淘金、由心及物 + 魔宗、奥术公理、无限循环往复、坦克引擎、豪猪、双持、神秘拳、自动施放、
魔法飞弹、天雷、依然在此、不灭（免死）、棱彩蛋（任务）、玻璃大炮（代价）……
[*][b]队友强化[/b]（有队友时才出现，队友不用装 Mod）：甘愿牺牲、防御策略、灵魂连接、号令之旗、音爆、神圣干预、晾衣绳……
[*][b]让经济[/b]：慷慨供养、守护之誓、举国之力，选中后指定要供养的队友
[*]银、金、棱彩三档，一局最多 2 个棱彩；每局 2 次刷新
[*]可选的[b]敌人海克斯[/b]（设置 EnemyAugments，默认关）：你每选一张，敌人也拿一张同品质的强化，作为补偿每次多 1 次刷新
[*]已选强化显示在头像下面，F7 列出
[*][b]联机[/b]：房间里每个人都装了同样的 Mod（版本也一样），或者房主在 F9 → Mod 页允许时生效；联机时只在休息阶段弹
[/list]

[h2]注意[/h2]
[list]
[*]0.4.0 起的新内容（联机、队友卡、第三到第五批）还没有在游戏里实测过，遇到问题请反馈。
[*]按游戏作者的规则，装了 Mod 后不能上传排行榜。
[*]界面目前只有中文。
[*]源码（MIT）和问题反馈：https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]
Description.english:
[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod Runtime (BepInEx + DBModKit)[/url] to be subscribed and installed first[/b] (the game's Workshop doesn't load code mods by itself). Once the runtime is installed, just subscribe; you'll be asked to confirm the first time it loads.

[b]0.31.0 needs the latest runtime: after updating, quit the game and run install.bat in the runtime item again.[/b]

4 picks per run (one at the start, then after the relic pick at about 1/4, 1/2 and 3/4 of the waves), inspired by LoL's ARAM: Mayhem and Arena.

[list]
[*][b]Signature-skill augments[/b]: damage, cooldown, mana cost, duration, charges, or on-cast effects like attack speed / armor / invulnerability / heal, cooldown refund on kills, a free extra cast
[*][b]Hand-made signature augments[/b] in silver / gold / prismatic: Desert Reaper's "Bonk", the Shotgun hero's "Cannon", Goblin King's "Stackosaurus", Bomber's "Nuke", Raiden's "Thunder God"
[*][b]Generic augments[/b] every hero can roll: Blunt Force, Deft, Goredrink, Gold Rush, Mind to Matter + Manamune, Arcane Axiom, Infinite Recursion, Tank Engine, Porcupine, Dual Wield, Mystic Punch, Auto-cast,
Magic Missile, Sky Strike, Still Here, Undying (cheat death), Prismatic Egg (quest), Glass Cannon (trade-off)...
[*][b]Teammate augments[/b] (only with teammates, who don't need the mods): Willing Sacrifice, Defensive Maneuvers, Spirit Link, Banner of Command, Sonic Boom, Divine Intervention, Clothesline...
[*][b]Feed the carry[/b]: Generous Patron, Guardian's Oath, All In — pick the teammate you support
[*]Silver, gold and prismatic tiers, max 2 prismatic per run; 2 rerolls per run
[*]Optional [b]enemy augments[/b] (config EnemyAugments, off by default): enemies get an augment of the same tier whenever you pick one, and you get an extra reroll per pick
[*]Chosen augments are shown under your portrait; F7 lists them
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: works when everyone in the room has the same mods (same versions) or the host allows it in F9 → Mod; picks only appear during the rest phase online
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Everything new since 0.4.0 (multiplayer, teammate augments, batches 3–5) hasn't been tested in game yet; please report problems.
[*]By the game author's rule, scores aren't uploaded to the leaderboard while mods are installed.
[*]The in-game UI is Chinese only for now.
[*]Source code (MIT) and issues: https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]

Title.schinese: DBStudio：游戏内 Mod 工作台

Description.schinese:
[b]需要先订阅并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod 运行环境（BepInEx + DBModKit）[/url][/b]（游戏的创意工坊不会自动加载代码 Mod）。装好运行环境后，订阅本条目即可，第一次加载时游戏里会让你确认。

按 F9 打开（单人时暂停游戏），游戏风格的窗口：

[list]
[*][b]调试[/b]：玩家属性、技能栏、附近敌人、运行记录；单人时有满血、满蓝、加金币等测试操作；"导出"生成诊断报告
[*][b]规则[/b]：不写代码做"当……如果……就……"的玩法
[*][b]强化[/b]：自己定义波次结束时的三选一强化
[*][b]数值[/b]：改技能、英雄、怪物数值，随时恢复原版
[*][b]皮肤[/b]：给每个英雄挑一套工坊模型，只改外观；Steam 联机时装了 Mod 的队友也能看到
[*][b]Mod[/b]：所有 Mod 的设置
[/list]
规则、强化、数值存成玩法包，联机时只有房间里每个人都装了一样的、或房主允许时才生效。

[h2]注意[/h2]
[list]
[*]按游戏作者的规则，装了 Mod 后成绩不会上传排行榜。
[*]界面目前只有中文。
[*]源码（MIT）和问题反馈：https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]
Description.english:
[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod Runtime (BepInEx + DBModKit)[/url] to be subscribed and installed first[/b] (the game's Workshop doesn't load code mods by itself). Once the runtime is installed, just subscribe; you'll be asked to confirm the first time it loads.

Press F9 to open it (pauses the game when you're alone):

[list]
[*][b]Debug[/b]: player stats, skill bar, nearby enemies, run log; test actions when alone; export a diagnostic report
[*][b]Rules[/b]: "when ... if ... then ..." gameplay without code
[*][b]Augments[/b]: your own pick-one-of-three upgrades at the end of waves
[*][b]Values[/b]: change skill, hero and monster numbers; restore vanilla any time
[*][b]Skins[/b]: pick a Workshop model per hero (cosmetic only); teammates with the mods see it in Steam lobbies
[*][b]Mod[/b]: settings of every mod
[/list]
Rules, augments and values are saved as gameplay packs; in multiplayer they only apply when everyone has the same packs or the host allows it.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]By the game author's rule, scores aren't uploaded to the leaderboard while mods are installed.
[*]The in-game UI is Chinese only for now.
[*]Source code (MIT) and issues: https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]

Title.schinese: 芙莉莲：无限魔力（内容包示例）

Description.schinese:
[b]需要先订阅并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod 运行环境（BepInEx + DBModKit）[/url][/b]（游戏的创意工坊不会自动加载 Mod）。装好运行环境后订阅本条目即可。

给精灵魔法使加一个变体英雄「芙莉莲」，专属技能换成被动 [b]无限魔力[/b]：法力永远是满的。

[h2]用法[/h2]
Mod 设置 → DBModKit → 英雄变体，给精灵魔法使选「芙莉莲」，然后照常选精灵魔法使开局。

[h2]模型[/h2]
模型用的是 CRIN 制作的 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3798456516]精灵魔法使-芙莉莲皮肤[/url]，需要另外订阅；没订阅时变体照样能用，只是显示原版模型。

[h2]关闭[/h2]
[list]
[*]只是这局不用：英雄变体里把精灵魔法使改回「原版」，下次开局生效。
[*]暂时关掉：主菜单 Mod → DBModKit → 内容包，在「芙莉莲」一行点「关闭」，会一直保持关闭，想用时再点「启用」。战斗中不能切换。
[*]彻底删除：取消订阅本条目。
[/list]
没在英雄变体里选芙莉莲时，精灵魔法使一直是原版。

[h2]内容包[/h2]
本条目是一个内容包：只有 JSON 和翻译，不含代码，可以当作自己做内容包的参考。写法见 https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods/blob/main/docs/内容包.md

[h2]注意[/h2]
[list]
[*]联机时只有房间里每个人都装了本条目（或房主允许）时才生效，否则只换模型。
[*]按游戏作者的规则，装了 Mod 后成绩不会上传排行榜。
[*]源码（MIT）和问题反馈：https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]
Description.english:
[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824690979]Mod Runtime (BepInEx + DBModKit)[/url] to be subscribed and installed first[/b] (the game's Workshop doesn't load mods by itself). Once the runtime is installed, just subscribe.

Adds a hero variant "Frieren" for the Elf Mage, whose signature skill becomes the passive [b]Infinite Mana[/b]: your mana is always full.

[h2]Usage[/h2]
Mod settings → DBModKit → Hero variants: pick "Frieren" for the Elf Mage, then start a run with the Elf Mage as usual.

[h2]Model[/h2]
The model is CRIN's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3798456516]Elf Mage - Frieren skin[/url], subscribe to it separately. Without it the variant still works with the original model.

[h2]Turning it off[/h2]
[list]
[*]Just this run: set the Elf Mage back to "Original" (原版) under Hero variants (英雄变体); applies from the next run.
[*]Temporarily: main menu Mod → DBModKit → Content packs (内容包), click "Disable" (关闭) on the Frieren row. It stays off until you enable it again. Can't be switched during combat.
[*]Completely: unsubscribe from this item.
[/list]
Unless you pick Frieren under Hero variants, the Elf Mage stays vanilla.

[h2]Content pack[/h2]
This item is a content pack: JSON and translations only, no code. Use it as a reference for making your own. Format: https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods/blob/main/docs/内容包.md (Chinese)

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]In multiplayer it only takes effect when everyone in the room has this item (or the host allows it); otherwise only the model changes.
[*]By the game author's rule, scores aren't uploaded to the leaderboard while mods are installed.
[*]Source code (MIT) and issues: https://github.com/plge0n/DungeonBrawlMods
[/list]
